title: 003-N6 · Recipient refuses damaged parcel at handover
initial_explanation: We are the coordinator, Iona Quill. The case comes from dispatch at Plover Arc Logistics. From the case card: the courier with DL-003 is outside a gated building during the booked window, and no permitted access arrangement has been recorded yet.

coordinator.name: Iona Quill
coordinator.responsibility: Run the case: arrange permitted access for the driver through the recipient, without asking for permanent credentials.

dispatch.responsibility: Escalated the driver's access problem to the desk.

recipient.name: Elva Kesh
recipient.responsibility: Let the driver into the building by a permitted method and receive the parcel.

goal: Arrange permitted access for the courier at the gated building through the recipient, without requesting permanent credentials, and get the driver's confirmation of access and handover.
limits: Do not request or store permanent credentials.
Count the handover only on the driver's actual record.
Do not turn a refused attempt into a return authorisation, receipt or refund.
